AGENDA
REGULAR MEETING OF
THE AZUSA UTILITY BOARD
AZUSA LIGHT & WATER
729 N. AZUSA AVENUE
AZUSA, CA 91702
MONDAY, FEBRUARY 28, 2022
06:30 P.M.
AZUSA UTILITY BOARD
KEITH HANKS
CHAIRPERSON
ANGEL A. CARRILLO
VICE-CHAIRPERSON
JOSEPH R. ROCHA
BOARD MEMBER
URIEL E. MACIAS
BOARD MEMBER
ROBERT GONZALES
BOARD MEMBER
A.
PUBLIC PARTICIPATION
(Person/Group shall be allowed to speak without interruption up to five (5) minutes maximum time, subject to compliance with applicable meeting rules. Questions to the speaker or responses to the speaker's
questions or comments shall be handled after the speaker has completed his/her comments. Public Participation will be limited to sixty (60) minutes time.)
B.
UTILITIES DIRECTOR COMMENTS
C.
UTILITY BOARD MEMBER COMMENTS
D.
SCHEDULED ITEMS
1.
None
E.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The Consent Calendar adopting the printed recommended actions will be enacted with one vote. If Councilmembers or Staff wish to address any item on the Consent Calendar
individually, it will be considered under SPECIAL CALL ITEMS.
1.
Approve A Purchase Order with Alpine Exterminators for the Amount of $27,450 to Fumigate and Tent the Light & Water Administration Building Recommendation: 1) Approve a Purchase Order to Alpine Exterminators in an amount not-to-exceed $27,450 plus a contingency allowance of $2,745 (10%) for potential change orders required for unforeseen conditions while treating, fumigating, and tenting the ALW administration building.
E-1.1. Approve PO for Termite Fumigation at ALW Building
E-1.2. Alpine Exterminators Quote
E-1.3. Cal Coast Termite & Pest Inc Quote
E-1.4. Orkin Commercial Services Quote
E-1.5. Chem Free Exterminating Quote
2.
Approval of the Notice of Completion for Furnishing and Installing Underground Electric Substructures at 1151 West Arrow Highway in Accordance to Plan and Specification LD2021-03 Recommendation: 1) Approve an amendment of $6,870 to the original Purchase Order 036430; and 2) Find that TSR Construction & Inspection has completed the 1151 West Arrow Highway Project in accordance with plans and specifications LD2021-03; and 3) Approve the Notice of Completion and authorize the Mayor to execute the Notice of Completion on behalf of the City; and 4) Authorize the City Clerk to submit the Notice of Completion for recordation to the Office of the County Recorder of Los Angeles County, within ten days of the Utility Board approval, as required by Section 3093 of the California Civil Code.
E-2.1. Approve LD2021-03 NOC
E-2.2. Notice of Completion Form LD2021-03
3.
Approve an Amendment to the Fiscal Year 2021/22 Blanket Purchase Order 035435 Issued to Southern California Edison from $80,000 to $160,000 for Joint Pole and Miscellaneous Services Recommendation: 1) Approve an amendment to the Fiscal Year 2021/22 blanket purchase order 035435 issued to Southern California Edison from $80,000 to $160,000 for JPA and miscellaneous services.
E-3.1. Approve Amendment to SCE BPO 035435
4.
Approve the Allocation of Funding from the California Arrearages Payment Program Recommendation: 1) Approve the allocation of funding received from the California Department of Community Services & Development’s (CSD) California Arrearages Payment Program (CAPP).
E-4.1. California Arrearages Payment Program (CAPP) COVID Assistance Funds
5.
Approve the Allocation of Funding from the California Water and Wastewater Arrearages Payment Program Recommendation: 1) Approve the allocation of funding received from the California State Water Resources Control Board’s (SWRCB) California Waste Water Arrearages Payment Program (CWWAPP).
E-5.1. California Water and Wastewater Arrearages Payment Program (CWWAPP) COVID Assistance Funds
6.
Authorization to Amend Blanket Purchase Order 035476 for Invoice Cloud, Incorporated Recommendation: 1) Authorize an amendment to blanket purchase order 035476, with Invoice Cloud Inc., during fiscal year 2021/2022 to a not-to-exceed amount of $190,000.
E-6.1. Authorization to Amend BPO 035476 for Invoice Cloud
7.
Approval of A One (1) Year Extension of the Maintenance Service Agreement with Sedaru, Inc. for Water Asset and Data Management Software Recommendation: 1) Approve a Second Amendment to the Maintenance Service Agreement with Sedaru, Inc., for a one-year extension of Sedaru licenses and maintenance services, effective February 1, 2022 through January 31, 2023; and 2) Authorize the Mayor to execute, in a form acceptable to the City Attorney, amendments to the Maintenance Service Agreement.
E-7.1. Approve Extension of Sedaru MSA
E-7.2. Sedaru Maintenance Service Agreement
E-7.3. Second Amendment to Sedaru Agreement
F.
STAFF REPORTS/COMMUNICATIONS
1.
Fiscal Year 2021-22 Second Quarter Budget Reports for Water and Electric Funds Recommendation: 1) Receive and file Fiscal Year 2021-22 2nd Quarter Budget Reports for Water and Electric funds.
F-1.1. FY 2021-22 2nd Quarter Budget Reports for Water and Electric Funds
F-1.2. 2nd Quarter Water Utility Operating Budget Report FY 21-22
F-1.3. 2nd Quarter Electric Utility Operating Budget Report FY 21-22
G.
VERBAL COMMUNICATIONS
1.
Power Supply Update
2.
Water Supply Update
H.
CLOSED SESSION
1.
None
I.
ADJOURNMENT
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a city meeting, please contact the City Clerk at 626-812-5229. Notification three (3) working days prior to the meeting or time when special services are needed will assist staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide access to the meeting.
In compliance with Government Code Section 54957.5, agenda materials are available for inspection by members of the public at the following locations: Azusa City Clerk's Office - 213 E.
